examples.title: Arbiter of Divinity: 10 verified items
examples.description: Import the equipment effects and level verified in the article into an estimate. Unverified settings are left blank.
omissions: Unverified support links, gem levels, allocated passives, jewels and reservation settings are left blank. This does not fully reproduce the Life, resistances or DPS shown in the screenshots.
Weapon sets use hypothetical arrangements for calculation. Switch between the two verified spears and the sceptre to compare them.

The number of filled body armour sockets and the conditions for Idols and Bonded modifiers could not be established. Socket-dependent attributes, Life and resistances, and unsupported special effects have not been filled in.
The unverified second ring, flasks and charms are left blank.

sourceItems.name: The Ordained
sourceItems.sourceText: Spear / The Ordained / Grand Spear / Quality +20%. Physical 206–309, Lightning 1–206, Critical Hit Chance 11.66%, Attacks per Second 1.40. Requires level 79, 65 Strength and 105 Dexterity. / 18% increased Physical Damage (light-blue line). Grants Spear Throw and level 19 Righteous Descent. 25% increased Melee Strike Range. 189% increased Physical Damage, Adds 1 to 206 Lightning Damage, +6.66% to Critical Hit Chance. Life Leech is based on Lightning Damage as well as Physical Damage. Creates one Fragment of Divinity in your Presence every 4 seconds. Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Skysliver
sourceItems.sourceText: Additional spear / Skysliver / Winged Spear / Quality +15%. Lightning Damage “1 or 84”, Critical Hit Chance 5.00%, Attacks per Second 2.15. Requires level 16, 12 Strength and 24 Dexterity. / +80 to maximum Life. Grants Spear Throw. No Physical Damage. Adds 1 to 84 Lightning Damage, 26% increased Attack Speed and 58% increased chance to Shock. Rolls only the minimum or maximum Damage value for each Damage Type.

sourceItems.name: Alpha's Howl
sourceItems.sourceText: Helmet / Alpha’s Howl / Runemaster Armoured Cap / Quality +20%. Evasion 466, Runeward 136. Requires level 65 and 87 Dexterity. / 15% increased Life Regeneration Rate and 18% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield (light-blue lines). 100% increased Evasion, +100 Spirit, +55% Cold Resistance and doubled Presence Radius. Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Morior Invictus
sourceItems.sourceText: Body armour / Morior Invictus / Grand Regalia / Quality +20%. Armour 983, Evasion 891, Energy Shield 270. Requires level 65, 39 Strength, 39 Dexterity and 39 Intelligence. / +36 maximum Life. 16% of Damage taken Recouped as Mana. +18% Lightning Resistance. 50% reduced effect of Curses. +10% of Armour also applies to Chaos Damage. Socketed Idols benefit from Bonded modifiers. Bonded: +5% Quality to all Skills and +8% Chaos Resistance. 350% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. Per filled socket: +7 to all Attributes, +11% Chaos Resistance and +56 maximum Life. Double-corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Shavronne's Satchel
sourceItems.sourceText: Belt / Shavronne’s Satchel / Fine Belt / Requires level 62. 3 Charm Slots. / Flasks gain 0.17 Charges per second. 26% reduced Life Recovery Rate from Flasks, +26 Intelligence and 20% increased Flask Charges gained. Life Recovery from Flasks also applies to Energy Shield. Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Rare Sirenscale Gloves
sourceItems.sourceText: Gloves / Rare Sirenscale Gloves / Quality +20%. Energy Shield 243. Requires level 80 and 97 Intelligence. / 8% increased Attack Speed (light-blue line). +51 maximum Energy Shield, 93% increased Energy Shield, 15% increased Attack Speed and +26 Dexterity. Adds 14 to 26 Physical Damage to Attacks and 11% increased Area of Effect of Attacks. Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Atziri's Step
sourceItems.sourceText: Boots / Atziri’s Step / Cinched Boots / Vaal boots. Quality +20%. Evasion 586. Requires level 65 and 83 Dexterity. / 18% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield (light-blue line). 30% increased Movement Speed, 102% increased Evasion and +81 maximum Life. Gain Deflection equal to 50% of Evasion. −10% to the amount of Damage prevented by Deflection. 19% increased Deflection while moving (red line). Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Guiding Palm of the Eye
sourceItems.sourceText: Sceptre / Guiding Palm of the Eye / Shrine Sceptre / Quality +20%. Spirit 100. Requires level 65, 16 Strength and 36 Intelligence. / Grants level 18 Purity of Ice. Gain 25% of Damage as Extra Cold Damage. Allies in your Presence gain 22 to 29 added Cold Damage to Attacks and 50% of your Base Life Regeneration. +23 Intelligence, 25% increased Light Radius and the effect of a Guiding Freezing Shrine. Corrupted.

sourceItems.name: Rare Stellar Amulet
sourceItems.sourceText: Amulet / Rare Stellar Amulet / Requires level 65. +5 to all Attributes. / +89 maximum Energy Shield, 28% increased maximum Energy Shield and +139 maximum Mana. +1 to Level of all Projectile Skills, +16 to all Attributes and +41% Lightning Resistance.

sourceItems.name: The Taming
sourceItems.sourceText: Verified ring / The Taming / Prismatic Ring / Requires level 42. 13% increased Rarity of Items found (light-blue line). / +8% and +20% to all Elemental Resistances (separate lines). 19% increased Damage per type of Elemental Ailment on the enemy. Wind skills that can be empowered by Elemental Ground Effects can be empowered by multiple Elemental Ground Effects and count as empowered by Burning, Shocked and Chilled Ground. Corrupted.
